claims: As of April 2026, Cameron Young's caddie is Kyle Sterbinsky.
Kyle Sterbinsky is Cameron Young's former teammate at Wake Forest University.
Since pairing with Kyle Sterbinsky, Cameron Young has two PGA Tour wins.
Since pairing with Kyle Sterbinsky, Cameron Young reached a high of third in the Official World Golf Rankings.
Before joining Cameron Young, Kyle Sterbinsky was playing on mini-tours.
Before joining Cameron Young, Kyle Sterbinsky was looking to transition from professional playing.
Kyle Sterbinsky was on the bag for Cameron Young’s victory at the 2025 Wyndham Championship.
Kyle Sterbinsky was on the bag for Cameron Young’s contention at the 2026 Players Championship.
Before teaming with Kyle Sterbinsky, Cameron Young worked with Paul Tesori in 2023.
Cameron Young previously worked with Scott McKean.
Cameron Young previously worked with Chad Reynolds.
There were recent reports of a potential rules violation regarding alignment in the 2026 Masters final round.
